title: A verified scientific result is reused by its evidence, never by its name
note: Run reuse on the governed model path: the identity task, GovernedModelRuns.reusable (every exclusion), propose's reuse branch, and the definition of the identity on the scientific side. Each exclusion's test uses a record that passes every other condition.

mutations.name: GR1_any_kind_is_reusable
mutations.rationale: a record of another kind is reused as a scientific result

mutations.name: GR2_any_state_is_reusable
mutations.rationale: a PROPOSED, UNDER_REVIEW or REJECTED result is reused

mutations.name: GR3_promoted_is_not_reusable
mutations.rationale: a PROMOTED result -- the strongest state -- is recomputed

mutations.name: GR4_the_record_citation_is_not_read
mutations.rationale: a record citing another identity is reused because its bundle matches

mutations.name: GR5_an_unreadable_bundle_stops_the_search
mutations.find:
except Exception:                        # noqa: BLE001
                # Unreadable, or not a bundle
mutations.replace:
except KeyError:                         # noqa: BLE001
                # Unreadable, or not a bundle
mutations.rationale: one missing or malformed bundle raises and stops every later proposal

mutations.name: GR6_the_bundle_identity_is_not_read
mutations.rationale: the record's citation is believed over the bundle's own provenance

mutations.name: GR7_artefacts_are_not_resolved
mutations.find: if not all(self.evidence.contains(a) for a in artifacts):
mutations.rationale: a result whose artefact is gone is reused

mutations.name: GR8_artefacts_are_looked_up_not_rehashed
mutations.replace: self.evidence.contains(a, verify=False) for a in artifacts
mutations.rationale: an artefact file with other bytes in it counts as intact

mutations.name: GR9_the_decision_is_not_rederived
mutations.rationale: a result whose cited report no longer resolves is reused

mutations.name: GR10_reuse_is_never_tried
mutations.rationale: an identical proposal runs the model again

mutations.name: GR11_a_reusable_result_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: the search runs and its answer is discarded

mutations.name: GR12_a_reused_run_can_be_checked
mutations.rationale: a reused result is checked again as if it were new

mutations.name: GR13_a_reused_run_can_be_decided
mutations.rationale: a reused, already-decided result is decided again

mutations.name: GR14_the_record_cites_no_identity
mutations.rationale: the record does not cite the identity its bundle carries, so nothing is ever reusable

mutations.name: GR15_one_record_per_content
mutations.rationale: an identical rerun collides with the first record by content

mutations.name: GR16_a_failed_identity_task_is_not_noticed

mutations.replace:

mutations.rationale: an identity task that failed is read as if it had succeeded

mutations.name: GR17_identity_over_unvalidated_parameters
mutations.rationale: the proposal's identity is over the raw parameters and the bundle's over the validated ones: they never agree, and invalid parameters are not caught before the run

mutations.name: GR18_the_bundle_records_no_identity
mutations.rationale: a bundle with no identity in its provenance

mutations.name: GR19_the_environment_leaves_the_identity
mutations.rationale: a result computed under another interpreter or numeric library is reused

mutations.name: GR20_the_implementation_leaves_the_identity
mutations.rationale: a result computed by other code is reused
